faq.question: Is a strong Day Master always better?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. A strong Day Master needs different balancing elements than a weak one. Both can succeed with proper structure.

faq.question: Can Day Master strength change over time?
faq.answer: The natal structure remains the same, but luck cycles can temporarily strengthen or weaken its influence.

content.text: The Day Master represents your core self in Bazi. It is determined by the Heavenly Stem of your Day Pillar and defines your elemental identity.
If your Day Master is supported by the seasonal element and reinforced by similar elements in the chart, it is typically considered strong.
Signs of a Weak Day Master
When controlling or draining elements dominate the chart and supportive elements are scarce, the Day Master may be classified as weak.
Day Master strength determines how you interact with wealth, power, and output elements, shaping life direction and strategy.
